adjudicated.ours: Mater Dei, dum stéteris in conspéctu Dómini,
adjudicated.ruling: The approved Benziger printing prints the offertory of the September feast as Recordáre, Virgo Mater Dei, dum stéteris in conspéctu Dómini (p. 672). The digital source prints Virgo Mater, in conspéctu Dei.
